notes.subject: ומתערה
notes.rationale: Lemma 6168 appears only here in the Tanakh; literal sense is 'make bare / pour out', hence 'spread itself wide'.

notes.subject: ומתערה
notes.rationale: Ancient versions and moderns divide: 'flourishing/spreading like a native tree' vs literal 'baring itself'; KJV 'spreading himself', BSB 'flourishing'.

notes.subject: עריץ
notes.rationale: 'Traipela man nogut' renders the sense 'feared, tyrannical', not the literal 'man i bilong skerim ol man'.

translation: Mi lukim wanpela man nogut, traipela man nogut, na em i spredim em yet olsem diwai bilong ples, grin na antap tru.

tokens.gloss: na em i spredim em yet
